name: @cursor-security/mcp
description: MCP server + CLI that audits project repositories for security posture across client, backend, secrets, dependencies, config, and agent trust.

scripts.security:self-check: npm run build && node --input-type=module -e "import { runDomainScan } from './dist/scanners/index.js'; const r = await runDomainScan('full', { projectPath: process.cwd() }); console.log(r.grade, r.overallScore, r.findings.length)"
